## RE:volution Mod v1.3.11

### Added

- Added cross-Location progression: completing a valid final Boss Zone unlocks the first configured stage of the next Location.
- Added an explicit `BOSS_ZONE` stage type instead of treating the last mob slot as a boss implicitly.
- Added `/stage location setboss <locationId> <mobSlotId>` and `/stage location clearboss <locationId> <mobSlotId>`.
- Added per-player persistent Fast-auto, configurable from the `L` travel menu.
- Added cross-Location navigation support for next/previous transitions.
- Added dynamic Boss labels in the travel menu based on current server-side stage type.
- Added regression coverage for Boss Zone validation, cross-Location unlocks, empty configured next stages, Fast-auto, revoke/reset interactions, server-side validation and network serialization.

### Fixed

- Fixed progression topology so an existing stage is recognized from its `LocationDefinition` even when it has no populated mobs yet.
- Fixed Location completion so a normal final mob slot cannot unlock the next Location without an explicit valid Boss Zone.
- Fixed travel menu labeling so removing Boss status returns the stage label to the normal `Mob N` form on the next server snapshot.

### Other

- Boss Zone is now an explicit extension point for future boss-specific mechanics.
- Dynamic boss HP scaling, boss ability rewards, per-player boss kill limits, procedural Location generation and boss-specific respawn policies are not part of v1.3.11.
- Existing legacy zones without an explicit zone kind remain compatible and are treated as normal mob zones.

### Download

Download `RE-volution-1.3.11.jar` from the assets attached to this GitHub Release.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-mod/compare/v1.3.10...v1.3.11
